Lamplighter

A small tool that turns Markdown notes into printable cards. Run lamp build in a folder of notes, or read the guide first.

Install

  1. Download the latest release.
  2. Unpack it into a folder on your PATH.
  3. Check that it runs:
lamp --version

Options

| Option | Meaning | | --- | --- | | --size | Card size, a6 or a7 | | --dark | Print light text on dark cards |

Before a release

  • [x] Update the changelog
  • [ ] Tag the version
  • [ ] Publish the notes

Cards print best on matte paper.
